11: the cardinal number that is the sum of ten and one
110: being ten more than one hundred
115: being five more than one hundred ten
11 november: the feast of Saint Martin; a quarter day in Scotland
11-plus: (formerly in Britain) an examination taken by 11 and 12 year old students to select suitable candidates for grammar school
110th: the ordinal number of one hundred ten in counting order
115th: the ordinal number of one hundred fifteen in counting order
11th: coming next after the tenth and just before the twelfth in position
